intent: Phase 7, fifth and last in the chain: put the coverage floors under a ratchet, so lowering a floor fails CI instead of passing it. Warrant WG-DEL-001 (B, floors per surface, ratchet only up). Source row WO-0013. Acceptance: (1) the !src/app/** exclusion deleted from collectCoverageFrom and a src/app/api band added; (2) every floor reset to the measured number rounded down, engine above service above UI; (3) floors moved into a shrink-only baseline checked by the same mechanism as design-lint. Done when lowering a floor fails CI instead of passing it. Tier proposal R2, anticipated factor ci-stateful-infra from derived signal ci-config, evidence the ratchet is a gate mechanism and the floors are read where CI runs the suite; public-contract may also activate, because the coverage configuration names src/app/api. This task and T-0025 build the same kind of guard, a baseline that cannot grow, and should share one mechanism rather than two.
